name: Sharon Annette Merithew
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Bicha-Dale Family Tree" (tree 8839537)
notes: Child of Harold Romeyn and Cleda Marie (Decker) Merithew; grandchild of Clyde Decker. Born 27 Mar 1939 at Howell, Michigan; married in Apr 1955 at Howell; died 11 Feb 1958 at Houston, Texas, aged 18, and was buried at Howell. The tree also lists a John Middlebrook as a husband.
